## About
Bobz World is in Los Fresnos, a handy stop on a beach trip to the island. We have a gift shop full of souvenirs and fun things for the whole family. You'll also find the arcade, glow in the dark mini golf, the ice cream area and Bobz Journey, with its wax figures and a path outside.
One reviewer told us she first came here with her husband when they were dating, and later brought their kids. That's the kind of place we hope to be. We're rated 4.3 on Google from 1679 reviews, and we'd love to see you on your next trip.

## Services
- Gift shop: Souvenirs and artsy, fun things for the whole family.
- Blacklight mini golf: Glow in the dark mini golf, indoors.
- Ice cream shop: Cool off with ice cream after golf or a day at the beach.
- Bobz Journey: A walk past wax figures, plus a path outside.
- Arcade: A small arcade with games to play.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my pet inside?
A: Only service animals are allowed inside, and pets in carriers can't come in either. If you're traveling with animals, plan your souvenir stop with that in mind.

Q: Is there anything to eat?
A: Along with the ice cream shop, we have small refreshments and snacks.

## What customers say
- "Tried to go shop for souvenirs after a beach trip but unable to bring in Chihuahua, sign posted no animals except service. Asked if they could come in with enclosed pet carrier but workers said not possible. Sign posted outside about theft responsibilities if car left unattended. So I didn't want to leave them with the car on. Lots of beautiful souvenirs but FYI if traveling with animals stop for souvenirs before you leave the island." (Rebecca Long, 5/5)
- "I haven’t been here in years, I’m my opinion it’s grown. They have a gift shop when you walk in. They have an arcade, glow in the dark mini-golf(9 holes), ice cream area, and Bobz Journey. Bobz Journey has wax figures, as well as a path outside. The outside of Bobz Journey could use some work. The employees were great, answered any questions we asked! I would recommend going to the arcade, mini-golf, gift shop and the ice cream area!" (Liyah Uvalle, 5/5)
- "🏝️🦖🦕 A staple of visiting SPI via the Valley! There’s a lot of fun, tourist type attraction & 📸 photo ops here. Things are over priced but it’s a must see at least ONCE. 😎" (Cori Muse, 5/5)
